question: Mallika Sarabhai was honoured with the Padma Bhushan in 2010 for her contribution to which of the following fields?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dance**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Mallika Sarabhai was honoured with the Padma Bhushan in 2010 for her exceptional contribution to the field of **Dance**.
 
• She is a celebrated Indian classical dancer, known primarily for her proficiency in the Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi dance forms.
 
• Mallika Sarabhai is also an accomplished choreographer and has been instrumental in using dance as a medium for social change.
